title: HookOutcome
description: The outcome of a hook evaluation under the Sheep Gate proof gate. Governs the consequence lifecycle: admission, refusal, and partial states. No direct action may bypass hook judgment. All outcomes produce a BLAKE3-verified receipt.
x-receipt-requirement: Every HookOutcome must produce a BLAKE3-verified receipt. Admitted outcomes authorize downstream consequences. Refused outcomes block downstream consequences. Partial outcomes defer receipt until sufficient evidence is available.

x-transitions.Refuse -> Admit: Lawful when additional evidence satisfies all gate criteria
x-transitions.Partial -> Admit: Lawful when sufficient evidence is collected
